mapper.sql: pr.place_review_id, pr.place_id, pr.user_id, u.nickname, pr.rating, pr.content, pr.verified_visit, pr.status, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, CASE WHEN #{requesterUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE pr.user_id = #{requesterUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} END AS owned_by_requester
mapper.select: SELECT FROM place_reviews pr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id WHERE pr.place_review_id = #{reviewId} AND pr.status = 'VISIBLE'

SELECT pr.place_review_id, pr.place_id, pr.user_id, u.nickname, pr.rating, pr.content, pr.verified_visit, pr.status, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, TRUE AS owned_by_requester FROM place_reviews pr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id WHERE pr.user_id = #{userId} AND pr.place_id = #{placeId} AND pr.status = 'VISIBLE'

SELECT FROM place_reviews pr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id WHERE pr.place_id = #{placeId} AND pr.status = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.place_review_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT pr.place_review_id, pr.place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.category AS place_category, p.address AS place_address, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order, pi.place_image_id LIMIT 1 ) AS place_image_url, pr.user_id, u.nickname, pr.rating, pr.content, pr.verified_visit, pr.status, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, TRUE AS owned_by_requester FROM place_reviews pr JOIN places p ON p.place_id = pr.place_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id WHERE pr.user_id = #{userId} AND pr.status = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY pr.updated_at DESC, pr.place_review_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM place_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM place_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 'VISIBLE' GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE place_reviews SET rating = #{rating}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE place_review_id = #{placeReviewId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'
